lyrics:
[Intro: muffled kick, filtered chords, far away]

[Loop: soft male falsetto, one phrase]
Here with you, like this
Here with you, like this

[Build: filter slowly opening, bass arriving]
Here with you, like this
Here with you, like this
(Exactly this)

[Swell: full bright chords, hi-hats, second voice an octave down]
Here with you, like this
Here with you, like this

[Break: beat drops out, one chord, the phrase alone]
Like this

[Peak: everything at full brightness, bells, noise swells]
Here with you, like this
Here with you, like this
(Exactly this)
Here with you, like this

[Outro: filter closes, muffled kick, one last "like this"]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, E-flat major. A long, slow swell from muffled warmth to dazzling brightness.

VOICE: Male, a soft, sweet falsetto singing one five-word phrase throughout. A second copy of his voice, pitched an octave down, joins later. A whispered aside in parentheses.

INSTRUMENTS: A four-on-the-floor kick that begins muffled and opens up, filtered organ-like chords, a warm bass, bright bells and glockenspiel at the peak, shuffling hi-hats, swells of white noise, a tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, muffled. 0:20 Loop begins. 0:50 Build, filter opening. 1:30 Swell. 2:06 Break, one chord. 2:20 Peak. 3:10 Outro, filter closes, ends 3:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s psychedelic house: saturated, warm and bright, everything pumping against the kick, voice inside the mix.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The peak arriving at 2:20.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 1 a.m. The emotional high point of the night, built from one sentence.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Content, glowing, overwhelmed, quiet.
